Wetness and localized specular term apply only inside visible lid aperture. Blink narrows that aperture without modifying indexed geometry; primary open/closed/open restores pixels. This is a shading model on existing skin, not an observed or separate spherical eyeball, physically fitted cornea or view-accurate optics claim.
